newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea will hold a news conference starting 1900 hours local to announce package of measures planned by the government to speed up reform, in line with suggestions made by international lenders.
* Trade unions earlier said they would support the government's package.
* The International Monetary Fund (IMF) will support the government's reform programme, Poul Thomsen, IMF chief negotiator for Romania said after meeting Senate chairman Petre Roman.
Thomsen said a first IMF tranche worth $400 million would be released within the next months. The effects of the government's reform programme should be felt by July, he said.
* Thomsen is expected to give a news conference on Tuesday on the government's reform package.
